comparison.objective: Compress a wound-drain bulb and cap it before releasing compression; the candidate preserves a gripper setting while locking a jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold spring-loaded faces compressed while pressing a hinged cap, without tugging tubing, versus concentric rotary tools and counter-torque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires sufficient sealed compression, cap seating, tube protection, and hand clearance; candidate requires angular accuracy and drift-free retention over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both require holding a state while applying a lock, but the shared pattern is generic; compression-and-capping does not exercise torque-coupled adjustment preservation.
